episodeTitle.en: The original growth hacker reveals his secrets | Sean Ellis (author of “Hacking Growth”)
episodeTitle.zh: 首席增长黑客揭秘秘籍 | 肖恩·埃利斯（《增长黑客》作者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Sean Ellis is one of the earliest and most influential thinkers and operators in growth. He coined the term “growth hacking,” invented the ICE prioritization framework, was one of the earliest people to use freemium as a growth lever, and, most famously, developed the Sean Ellis Test for product-market fit (which a large percentage of founders use today to track if they’ve found PMF). Over the course of his career, Sean was head of growth at Dropbox and Eventbrite; helped companies like Microsoft and Nubank refine their growth strategy; was on the founding team of LogMeIn, which sold for over $4 billion; and is the author of one of the most popular growth books of all time, Hacking Growth, which has sold over 750,000 copies. In our conversation, he shares: • The proper use of the Sean Ellis Test for measuring product-market fit
guestBioOfficial.zh: 肖恩·埃利斯是增长领域最早且最具影响力的思想领袖和实干家之一。他创造了“增长黑客”一词，发明了ICE优先级框架，率先将免费增值模式作为增长杠杆，并最著名的开发了用于验证产品市场契合度的肖恩·埃利斯测试（如今大量创业者借此追踪是否找到了PMF）。职业生涯中，肖恩曾担任Dropbox和Eventbrite的增长负责人，助力微软和Nubank等公司优化增长策略，参与创立了以40亿美元估值出售的LogMeIn，并著有畅销增长类书籍《增长黑客》，该书累计销量超75万册。在对话中，他将分享：• 正确使用肖恩·埃利斯测试衡量产品市场契合度
